answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> Islamic Beliefs Question ID: 8602 Country: Pakistan Title: Assalam-u-Aliekum, Some Biblical prophets are not mentioned in Qur?an for e.g. Isaiah, Jeremiah, Amos, etc. What Islam says about those who are not mentioned in Qur?an? Question: Assalam-u-Aliekum, Some Biblical prophets are not mentioned in Qur?an for e.g. Isaiah, Jeremiah, Amos, etc. What Islam says about those who are not mentioned in Qur?an? Answer ID: 8602 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 21421646=H/1429) We are asked to believe in all the prophets sent down by Allah whether they mentioned in the Quran or not. If Isaiah, Jeremiah and Amos also were prophets then we have to believe in them. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
